title: FleetWatch session state file
description: One file per agent session at $XDG_STATE_HOME/fleet/sessions/<session_id>.json (default ~/.local/state). Write it atomically (temp file in the same directory, then rename) with mode 0600 in a 0700 directory, and delete it when the session ends. The reader trusts the newest observed_at only while it is fresh, so keep writing on activity.

session_id.description: Must equal the file name without .json.

pid.description: The agent process id; 0 when unknown. Used to join a session the reader could not bind by id.

reason.description: Short human-readable cause, shown on the board.

hook_event.description: The event that produced the write, for example PermissionRequest.

pane.description: Terminal pane id such as a tmux %3; empty when none.
